# Tri-State Electric

> > Full-service electrical contractor providing specialized infrastructure solutions across El Paso, Las Cruces, and the tri-state region.

Tri-State Electric, Ltd. is an established electrical contracting firm founded by David C. Fuller, specializing in high-voltage systems, excavation, fiber-optic installation, and traffic management services. The company serves government agencies, municipalities, and private clients throughout Texas and surrounding areas.

## Key Topics

- Electrical contracting
- High-voltage systems
- Traffic management
- Fiber-optic installation
- Government subcontracting
- El Paso
- Las Cruces
- Construction services
- Excavation
- Infrastructure development
- Insured and bonded
- CDL drivers
- Bilingual services
- Texas contractor
